about:
A&E Unique LLC, also operating as Red Lion Apparel LLC, is based in Denver, Colorado, where it runs a home office at 4700 Wyandot Street. The company focuses on custom-decorated apparel for business promotion, team sports, memorials, and personal expression. No founding year or ownership structure is publicly disclosed.

The shop produces custom branded clothing using direct-to-film (DTF) printing, rhinestone application, glitter flake, vinyl cutting, reflective material, and other heat-pressed media. It offers design assistance, accepting customer artwork and providing estimates based on quantity. All work is performed in-house at the Denver location, though the company does not disclose facility size, headcount, or annual volume.

Customers include local businesses seeking promotional shirts, sports teams needing uniforms, families ordering memorial wear, and automotive enthusiasts such as the North Denver Red Lion Car Club. The company also serves individuals looking for inspirational or personal statement garments.

The business emphasizes quality garments that make wearers feel confident and comfortable, and it highlights the revival of the Red Lion brand on Denver's north side as a point of distinction.
